items.translation: El sol sale por el este.

items.sentence: She ____ three kids on her own.

items.translation: Deja que la masa suba una hora.

full_script: [curious] ¿Sabes cuándo se dice RAISE y cuándo RISE? Completa las diez frases y descubre tu nivel. The sun rises in the east. Raise your hand, please. Prices rise every year. They raised my rent last month. The river rose after the rain. Don't raise your voice at me. Sales have risen by ten percent. She raised three kids on her own. Let the dough rise for an hour. She rose to the challenge. Si llegaste a la tres, eres nivel básico. Hasta la siete, intermedio. Y si sabías las diez, eres experto. [excited] ¿Hasta qué número llegaste?
